thread-safety.name: Thread Safety
thread-safety.one_line_summary: Guarantee that shared mutable state behaves correctly when accessed by multiple threads concurrently without data races or corruption.

race-condition.name: Race Condition
race-condition.one_line_summary: A timing bug occurring when two or more threads read and write shared data concurrently, causing the final output to depend on unpredictable execution order.

volatile.name: volatile keyword
volatile.one_line_summary: Ensures CPU memory visibility across threads by bypassing core CPU caches and prohibiting compiler instruction reordering (establishing happens-before).

cas.name: Compare-And-Swap (CAS)
cas.one_line_summary: A hardware-level CPU instruction that atomically updates a memory location only if it still holds the expected value, enabling non-blocking lock-free loops.

happens-before.name: Happens-Before Relationship
happens-before.one_line_summary: A formal guarantee in the JMM that memory writes by one action are visible to a subsequent read action without race conditions.

hash-bucket-array.name: Hash Bucket Array
hash-bucket-array.one_line_summary: An underlying array of buckets where keys are hashed and mapped to array indices, resolving collisions via linked nodes or trees.

treeification.name: Bucket Treeification
treeification.one_line_summary: Java 8+ optimization converting a hash collision linked-list bin into a Red-Black tree once it exceeds TREEIFY_THRESHOLD (8) and table capacity >= 64.

concurrent-hash-map.name: ConcurrentHashMap
concurrent-hash-map.one_line_summary: High-throughput thread-safe map utilizing per-bucket CAS for empty bins and synchronized locks on individual bin heads, with cooperative multi-threaded resizing.

copy-on-write-array-list.name: CopyOnWriteArrayList
copy-on-write-array-list.one_line_summary: Thread-safe list making a fresh clone of the underlying array upon every write, allowing lightning-fast lock-free snapshot reads without ConcurrentModificationException.

reentrant-lock.name: ReentrantLock
reentrant-lock.one_line_summary: Explicit mutex built on AbstractQueuedSynchronizer (AQS) supporting fair/unfair policies, interruptible lock acquisition, and multiple condition variables.

executor-service.name: ExecutorService & ThreadPoolExecutor
executor-service.one_line_summary: Framework managing worker threads, task queues (BlockingQueue), lifecycle termination, and rejected execution handling to eliminate manual thread creation.

blocking-queue.name: BlockingQueue
blocking-queue.one_line_summary: Queue that blocks producer threads when full (put) and blocks consumer threads when empty (take), standard for producer-consumer pipelines.

virtual-threads.name: Virtual Threads (Project Loom / Java 21+)
virtual-threads.one_line_summary: Lightweight user-mode threads managed by the JVM instead of the OS, scheduled on carrier OS threads via ForkJoinPool to enable massive non-blocking concurrency.
